summary: Lithia Motors filed an 8-K on July 29, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results and announcing a $0.70 per share quarterly cash dividend, a 23% increase, payable August 21, 2026 to shareholders of record August 7, 2026. The filing includes routine earnings release, repurchase activity of $242 million during the quarter, and a dividend increase. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is present. The dividend and share buybacks are ordinary capital allocation activities, not a transformative special situation.
